operatingModel: AI-first: AI does all engineering, testing, review and evidence. Human decisions are a FINAL stage, not a working dependency. Deferred gates never become PASS or VERIFIED by AI; they keep their safety labels until a qualified human acts.
denominatorPolicy: v2 starts with a NEW baseline: engineering criteria are counted separately from external gates. A criterion is PASS only with all evidence for the exact SHA; otherwise FAIL or NOT_RUN. No v2 criterion is VERIFIED. Deferred final-stage gates are reported beside the engineering count and never removed to raise a percentage. The legacy ledger stays read-only history.
